senses.gloss:
f. (-डा)
1 The wife of BUDDHA, daughter of IKṢVĀKU.
2 The earth.
3 A cow.
4 Speed.
5 A tubular vessel, one of the principal channels of the vital spirit, that which is on the right side of the body.
6 Heaven.
7 The goddess of speech.
E.
इल to direct or send, क affix, and टाप् fem. ल and ड are interchangeable: see इला.

r. 2nd cl. (ईट्टे) also 10th cl. (ईडयति)
To praise.

f. (-डा)
Praise.
E.
ईड to praise. क and टाप् affs.

f. (-का)
A wasp.
E.
इडा the earth, चर to go, and ड्वन् aff.

n. (-णं)
Praising.
E.
ईड and ल्युट् aff.
